SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, m.nickname, p.title, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content, 100, 1) AS content_preview, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at, ( SELECT '/api/attachments/' || a.attachment_id || '/image' FROM attachments a WHERE a.post_id = p.post_id AND a.upload_type = 'THUMBNAIL' AND a.is_deleted = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_url, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id AND pl.member_id = #{memberId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked, CASE WHEN #{memberId} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.post_id = p.post_id AND b.member_id = #{memberId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bookmarked FROM posts p JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.is_deleted = 'N' AND p.is_temp = 'N' AND p.is_public = 'Y' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.is_deleted = 'N' AND p.is_temp = 'N' AND p.is_public = 'Y'
